Call one with mcp_call(tool: "<server>/<tool>", args: {…}).

fake/navigate_page: Go to a URL in the selected page.
inputSchema: {"type":"object","properties":{"url":{"type":"string"}},"required":["url"]}

fake/take_screenshot: Take a screenshot of the page or of an element on the page.
inputSchema: {"type":"object","properties":{"fullPage":{"type":"boolean"}}}
